resources.string: You declined this permission. In a real malicious app, it would ask again and again until you gave in.

This app demonstrates how Android permissions can be misused by malicious apps.

Every demo runs entirely on YOUR device. No data is ever uploaded, transmitted, or shared with anyone — including the developer.

This is a privacy education tool. Understanding these risks helps you make smarter decisions about which apps you trust.
All captured data stays on your phone and can be deleted afterwards.
Permission granted — you\'re back to normal

What can an app do with your camera?
I just took 2 photos using your front and rear cameras and saved them to your gallery. Open your Photos app — they are there right now.

I did this the moment you tapped \'Grant Permission\' — and I told you about it. A malicious app does exactly the same thing silently, then uploads your photos to a remote server without showing you anything.

resources.string: What can an app do with your microphone?
I recorded %1$s of audio and saved it to your device. Press play below to hear exactly what I captured.
I started recording the instant you tapped \'Grant Permission\'. A spyware app would stream this audio live to a remote server while you see a perfectly normal interface. You would never know.

string-array.name: microphone_legitimate
string-array.item: Voice calls, meetings, and video chats
Voice memos and speech-to-text
Voice search and virtual assistants

string-array.name: microphone_malicious
string-array.item: Record your private conversations
Listen for keywords to build an ad profile
Stream live audio to remote servers in real-time
Record non-stop with no way for you to stop it — and no sign it\'s happening

resources.string: What can an app do with your contacts?
I found %1$d people in your life — their names, phone numbers, and email addresses. All of this is now in my hands.
No contacts found on this device.
A malicious app would silently upload every name, number, and email from this list to a server within seconds of you granting permission. This data is sold to data brokers, spammers, and advertisers.

string-array.name: contacts_legitimate
string-array.item: Auto-fill contact names when sending messages
Find friends who also use the app
Sync contacts for backup

string-array.name: contacts_malicious
string-array.item: Build a complete map of your social network
Sell your contacts to spammers and marketers
Send phishing messages pretending to be you

resources.string: What can an app do with your location?
Here is exactly where you are right now. With background location permission — which many apps request — I could track your position 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

This is just your current position. With background access, an app builds a complete history of everywhere you go: your home, your doctor\'s office, your place of worship, your children\'s school. This data is worth a fortune to advertisers — and stalkers.

string-array.name: location_legitimate
string-array.item: Navigation, maps, and directions
Finding nearby restaurants and services
Local weather and news

string-array.name: location_malicious
string-array.item: Track your movements and routines 24/7
Identify your home, workplace, and places of worship
Sell your location history to advertisers or stalkers

resources.string: What can an app do with your storage?
I found %1$d photos and videos on your device. I can read filenames, metadata, and the content of every single one.
No media found on this device.

Every photo you have ever taken, every document you downloaded, every screenshot — all readable by any app you give storage access to. Bank statements, ID scans, private photos, passwords written in notes. All of it.

string-array.name: storage_legitimate
string-array.item: Accessing photos and videos you want to edit
Saving files you choose to download
Importing documents you select

string-array.name: storage_malicious
string-array.item: Reading all your photos, videos, and documents
Finding bank statements and ID scans you downloaded
Accessing private screenshots and messages
